_about: Lockheed L-1011 Maintenance Manual, 6-10-00 Figure 2, Aircraft Dimensions - Plan View (page 3, Dec 1/71): page index 9, layers.py --mode image --threshold 150 at scale 4.396, clip 60,190,530,700, --rotate -0.67. The plan is drawn at 0.910 of the side's scale (rendered to it: nose to tail cone 1756 px against the side's 1753) and turned 0.67 degrees (its fuselage's centreline ran from y 900 at x 600 to 890 at x 1450; turned, the fuselage, wing tips and tailplane tips share one centreline at y 894). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side, the same as its left). The nose tip is on an extension line (a free point). The S-duct intake's fairing from above is the open box ahead of the fin (tail.halfWidth); behind it the fairing blends into the fin and isn't drawn. The wing's leading edge is the slats' outer line; the inboard trailing edge runs nearly straight out to the kink at the outboard flap.
